description: List this account's most recent scrapes, newest first (the API keeps the latest 200): id, title, status, resultCount, credits charged and dates. Use it to find a scrape id or to reuse a finished scrape instead of paying for the same search again.

limit.description: How many scrapes to return (1-200, default 20).

status.description: Only return scrapes with this status.

name: list_scrapes
title: List scrapes
